The Phase 1 audit baseline remains 9b8545ed6ecf98b337326390400076e36789e056, and the audit record of reference is hhh/audit/HHH_MASTER_GAME_AUDIT_v0.1.md against the approved Blueprint hhh/blueprint/HHH_CURRICULUM_BLUEPRINT_v1.0.md. The game is unmodified by this release.
Runtime case identity: C2 L3, The Quiet Billion, Mexico and South Asia in 1968. instructionalType CORE_CASE, displayOrder 12.

One game finding, and it is not a blocker. HHH-GAME-C2L3-001 is a curriculum qualification, CURRICULUM_QUALIFICATION_REQUIRED and OPEN_AT_AUDITED_GAME_BASELINE by design. The audit found the core semi-dwarf, lodging and rust story sound but held that exact field-yield claims and any "one seed saved a billion" shorthand must not replace broader irrigation, fertiliser and institutional context. The package carries that qualification in every role, does not modify the game, does not reopen the game audit and leaves the shared remediation tracker untouched. This case carries no GAME_REMEDIATION_BLOCKS_FINALIZATION dependency.

Eight visible tasks carry the Core Case spine, and the culminating product is a Qualified Historical Finding rather than canonical CER. CER is declined on the ground Cases 06, 07, 08 and 09 established: the finding holds five separately scored obligations - what the evidence supports, at least one quantitative India value or trend with its units and scope, at least one additional documented source, other contributing conditions together with something the evidence does not prove, and the additional evidence that would better isolate the varietal effect - and a single claim/evidence/reasoning sequence would flatten the three the case exists for. No role renders the shared canonical CER component and no role declares a CER contract.

Task 2 is deliberately non-keyable. It records what a learner would require before treating "a billion lives were saved" as a measured fact, taken after the reconstructed records and before the documented sources arrive, there is no correct answer, and the Answer Key omits it without renumbering. The later tasks keep their Student numbers, the Teacher Guide carries the guidance for reading it diagnostically, and no learner page states any grading policy.

Complete in-packet no-game dossier. Campaign 2 has no level selector and no direct-launch mode, so every assessed strand is printed: Sources A to E are the reconstructed game evidence - the recovered Borlaug record, the two wheats, the pedigree records, Dr. Rao's deployment testimony and the Failure Report - and Sources F to I are the four documented sources. Sources A to D are runtime-required; Source E is runtime-optional and curriculum-assessed, so it is printed in full and no learner's ability to complete Task 6 depends on finding it in play. The Teacher Guide supplies both a gameplay route and a complete no-game route, in terms that make neither the reduced version.

Source estate: the Phase 1 audit is not modified. Four real-world sources and no others support every claim the packet makes about the world - the Government of India, Directorate of Economics and Statistics, Agricultural Statistics at a Glance 2015, Table 4.7(a), "Wheat: All-India Area, Production and Yield alongwith coverage under Irrigation", crop years 1964-65 to 1969-70; Norman E. Borlaug's Nobel Lecture, "The Green Revolution, Peace, and Humanity", 11 December 1970, a primary participant source; CIMMYT, "From east Asia to south Asia, via Mexico: how one gene changed the course of history"; and Prabhu L. Pingali, "Green Revolution: Impacts, limits, and the path ahead", PNAS, 2012, 109(31):12302-12308. The audit's certified pointer H15 is recorded as reused but is not relied on for any printed claim. The bounds are machine-readable in source/task-registry.js under sourceCertification, and no historical, biographical, chronological, quantitative or institutional claim appears anywhere in the package that is not on one of those lists.

The six-year India series is pinned to a stated statistical edition, which the PMO bounded remediation added. Later editions revise some historical values; that is a reason to cite the edition, which the packet does in the learner Source F card, in the Teacher source estate and in sourceCertification, and not an error in these pages. Its internal arithmetic is self-consistent: area multiplied by yield reproduces production to within published rounding in all six crop years.

The title boundary is structural. "A billion lives" is the game's language and is not a Case 10 historical statistic; both learner editions print on page 1 that it is a claim requiring a stated method and counterfactual rather than a measurement supplied by this packet. No task asks a learner to calculate, repeat, validate or endorse a numerical lives-saved figure, no exemplar states one, and the Answer Key refuses one at every level.

Two-layer truth is structural, not editorial. Three source-status bands are marked in markup as data-evidence-layer and in printed text as a SOURCE STATUS band on every evidence object, and the non-merger rule is printed on page 1 of both learner editions: reconstructed game evidence can support reasoning inside the case but cannot establish a real historical claim, and a documented source can support claims about the Green Revolution but cannot prove that a game record is genuine.

Standards: six directly assessed - C3 D2.His.14.6-8, C3 D3.3.6-8, C3 D3.4.6-8, C3 D4.1.6-8, CCSS RH.6-8.7 and CCSS WHST.6-8.1 - two supporting, C3 D3.2.6-8 and CCSS RH.6-8.8, and no contextual standard. No NGSS performance expectation is claimed at any status.

Declared Accessible adaptations: exactly five, and no sixth - t3-figure-row-modelled, t4-first-read-modelled, t5-route-mostly-supplied, t6-modelled-comparison and t7-first-position-modelled. Everything else changes the route rather than the demand, and all five obligations of the Qualified Historical Finding remain. Edition parity is enforced structurally through editionResponseContract, and Accessible pagination is continuous flow.

Regression protection retained by the release: five closed negative semantic classes - livesSavedAsMeasurement, seedAloneCausation, productionIsYield, dwarfingCausesRust and productionEndsHunger - each anchored to a named subject register, each requiring an affirmative unnegated predicate, and each paired with a positive structural requirement checked against markup, shipping negative controls the validator must flag and positive controls it must not. Exemptions are concept-scoped: only the two classes the game itself asserts are excused inside a reconstructed evidence object or a marked in-game quotation, the other three are excused nowhere in the learner editions at all, and a mutation control proves that an exemption allowing two classes cannot quietly excuse the other three. Also retained: the three-band source-status contract, the case-local source certification bounds, the locked six-year quantitative record, the transmission route, the production package, the claim test, the three competing interpretations, the Case 10-local Answer-Key evidence-reachability guard added by the independent-review remediation, the sixty-minute total route arithmetic, task-reference parity, the edition response contract, the standards lock, page identity, persistent response controls and HTML-only enforcement.

Visible learner provenance follows shared/visual-style-guide/amendments/STUDENT_FACING_METADATA_AND_VISUAL_HIERARCHY_v1.0.1.md: every learner-visible band is the short controlled label and nothing else, while the machine-readable evidence-layer markup is unchanged and is what validation binds to.

This release claims no SSS legacy exemption. It is a full current-contract release with frozen Student, Teacher and Answer Key DOM baselines; the Accessible DOM hash was additionally computed and compared at both trees to prove parity across all four roles.
